targets.notes: Normal product flash operations remain disabled. 0B-P1 qualified the deterministic YWD-1278 artifact hash. 0B-P2 physically requalified the 131072-byte main-flash geometry using two independent full reads through the YWD-1278 backup path; both reads were byte-identical and matched stock SHA256 4981b35b2d50ada0b09322d9de19dd58a0cbd49eb005693499d1acae92f9d684. The 0B-P3 qualification_write gate is separate from flash_enabled and is restricted to a same-run exact-artifact write/readback/identity check followed by exact protected-stock restore. GPIO20=BOOT0 and GPIO21=RESET are physically qualified for application state and explicit system-bootloader entry/restart. Option-byte writes are forbidden.
